title: Chinese chestnut shell polyphenol extract regulates the JAK2/STAT3 pathway to alleviate high-fat diet-induced, leptin-resistant obesity in mice.
authors: Liu, Suwen; Jiang, Wenhong; Liu, Chang; Guo, Shuo; Wang, Hao; Chang, Xuedong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究板栗壳多酚提取物通过JAK2/STAT3通路改善肥胖小鼠代谢，仅含少量小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Chinese chestnut shell is a by-product of chestnut food processing and is rich in polyphenols. This study sought to investigate the effect of chestnut shell polyphenol extract (CSP) on weight loss and lipid reduction in a 12-week high-fat diet (HFD)-induced murine obesity model. CSP (300 mg per kg body weight) was administered intragastrically daily. AG490, a JAK2 protein tyrosine kinase inhibitor, was also intraperitoneally injected. The results showed that an HFD induced leptin resistance (LR). Compared to corresponding values in the HFD group, CSP treatment improved blood lipid levels, weight, and leptin levels in obese mice (p < 0.01). Additionally, CSP treatment enhanced enzyme activity by improving total antioxidant capacity, attenuating oxidative stress, and reducing fat droplet accumulation and inflammation in the liver, epididymal, and retroperitoneal adipose tissue. CSP also activated the LEPR-JAK2/STAT3-PTP1B-SOCS-3 signal transduction pathway in hypothalamus tissue and improved LR while regulating the expression of proteins related to lipid metabolism (PPARgamma, FAS, and LPL) in white adipose tissue in the retroperitoneal cavity. However, the amelioration of lipid metabolism by CSP was dependent on JAK2. Molecular docking simulation further demonstrated the strong binding affinity of procyanidin C1 (-10.3983297 kcal mol(-1)) and procyanidin B1 (-9.12686729 kcal mol(-1)) to the crystal structure of JAK2. These results suggest that CSP may be used to reduce HFD-induced obesity with potential application as a functional food additive.
abstract_zh: 板栗壳是板栗食品加工的副产物，富含多酚类物质。本研究旨在探讨板栗壳多酚提取物（CSP）在12周高脂饮食（HFD）诱导的小鼠肥胖模型中对减重和降脂的作用。每日通过灌胃给予CSP（300 mg/kg体重），同时腹腔注射JAK2蛋白酪氨酸激酶抑制剂AG490。结果表明，HFD诱导了瘦素抵抗（LR）。与HFD组相应值相比，CSP处理改善了肥胖小鼠的血脂水平、体重和瘦素水平（p < 0.01）。此外，CSP处理通过提高总抗氧化能力、减轻氧化应激、减少肝脏、附睾及腹膜后脂肪组织中的脂滴积累和炎症，增强了酶活性。CSP还激活了下丘脑组织中的LEPR-JAK2/STAT3-PTP1B-SOCS-3信号转导通路，改善了LR，同时调节了腹膜后腔白色脂肪组织中脂质代谢相关蛋白（PPARγ、FAS和LPL）的表达。然而，CSP对脂质代谢的改善依赖于JAK2。分子对接模拟进一步证明了原花青素C1（-10.3983297 kcal mol(-1)）和原花青素B1（-9.12686729 kcal mol(-1)）与JAK2晶体结构的强结合亲和力。这些结果表明，CSP可能用于减轻HFD诱导的肥胖，并具有作为功能性食品添加剂的潜在应用价值。
